name: Vertical Frequency
description: A prestige neural-feed drama produced by an Axiom-adjacent independent studio, following a corporate compliance officer in the Spire who begins covertly investigating her own employer after discovering that a series of Shelf infrastructure failures were not accidents. The show is structured as a procedural but uses the neural-feed format to place viewers inside the protagonist's memory and risk calculations rather than action sequences — the tension comes from sitting with what she knows and what she chooses not to act on. It is widely regarded as the finest corporate intrigue drama of the 2220s.
cultural_impact: The show's protagonist, Mireille Osei-Kaufmann, became a cultural shorthand for the dilemma of institutional complicity — 'doing a Mireille' entered Tier 3-4 professional slang for the act of knowing something and choosing procedural action over direct disclosure.
story_hooks: The show's lead writer has gone silent on all public channels six months before Season 2 was due to begin production.
A Tier 2 infrastructure technician contacts the production claiming the show's fictional failure scenarios match actual incident reports they were ordered to falsify.
Someone inside Axiom is quietly purchasing the rights to the show's source material — a move that would give them creative control over any future seasons.
